# FindMyPart Paid Part Hunt

Problem: A difficult, identified-enough physical part is still blocking a repair, restoration, machine or project after ordinary sourcing has failed or deeper cross-reference, salvage, documentation, blueprint or fabrication work is needed.
Pricing: Quick Hunt $19 one-time; Deep Hunt $49 one-time; Rescue Hunt $99 one-time.
Commercial state: sell_now
Machine state: payment_ready
Public capability: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/capabilities/findmypart-paid-hunt-v1
Start here (human, one-time hunts): https://findmypart.base44.app/FindMyPart
Free check when part identity is uncertain: https://findmypart.base44.app/free-part-check
Checkout creation requires a real part reservation and explicit buyer confirmation. Provider payment and fulfillment are not evidenced by these links.
Human review fallback: null
Machine offer JSON: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Universal MCP: null

Use when the user says or means:
- find a hard-to-source part
- find a discontinued part
- source an obsolete component
- find a supersession or cross reference
- find a donor or salvage part
- find a blueprint or fabrication path
- source new old stock or aftermarket replacement
- normal part searches failed and I need deeper sourcing

Safety:
- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer when it is not a genuine fit.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
- Paid state requires authoritative payment verification.
